title: Late for Work
summary: Mr. Ted went home at 6 o'clock. He was hungry. The dinner will be ready in half an hour. He missed the train this morning. He caught the 9.15 train. The boss wasn't angry, because he missed the train too.

title: Help!
summary: I'm staying at The Royal Hotel. I heard a shout while walking pass the room. I got into the room. They were not quarrelling. They were actors. They were learning their parts.

title: A Pair of Glasses
summary: I tested my eyes last week. My wife thought that I needed a pair of glasses. I went to an optician. I would buy plastic frames. I broke the optician's mirrors. I missed the mirror that the optician handed. My wife was right.

title: Our New Secretary
summary: The telephone rang. Miss Simpson answered it. It was Mr. Bright, he wanted to offer the typewriter to Mr. Calder, but he didn't need it. Miss Simpson told Mr. Bright that Mr. Calder said that he was not in his office.

title: Two Tramps and A Dog
summary: A dog was following two tramps on a road. The tramps had not any money. Suddenly a car was coming towards them. The tramps moved to the side but the dog didn't. It got hit and died. The driver was sorry and gave 5 pounds to the first tramps. They had no idea whose dog it was.

title: The Horse Couldn't Sing
summary: I went to the opera last night. I didn't see the whole opera. Everyone left before the end of the performance. There were two live horses in the opera. One of the horses jumped off the stage. I had to leave. Perhaps, the horse couldn't sing.

title: Easy to Drive
summary: A car was outside the showroom. A salesman noticed the crowd. The car was an automatic car. He would give a demonstration. He drove backward instead and broke the window.

title: It's Never Too Late
summary: Tommy wrote a letter to his aunt two weeks ago. His mother came into his room. She was surprised. He never writes letters. He had written two lines. He would read the letter. He thanked his aunt for last year's present.

title: The Amateur Photographer
summary: Mr. Mead will have the film developed and printed in a chemist's shop. It will be ready on Tuesday. Mr. Mead returned the following Tuesday. The photographs were not successful. He spoiled the film. He will never become a good photographer.

title: It's Quicker on Foot
summary: Frank had pressed the button. The lift was coming from the fourth floor. Juddy was going to walk down the stairs. She didn't hurry but she arrived earlier than Frank. The lift had stopped between floors.

title: First Flight
summary: There were 5 tourists on the local flight. The passengers had to fasten their seatbelts. An old lady needed help, she felt nervous because it was her first flight. The air hostess gave her some sweets to help her swallow. She wanted other sweets.

title: Dinner For Two
summary: Max lived in a small flat. He was a good cook. He had been preparing dinner for 5 hours. It was a Mexican dish. His sister came. She would stay for dinner. He wasn't expecting company. He intended to eat them all by himself.

title: The Student Teacher
summary: Last year, John went to Italy. He didn't intend to stay there for two months. He taught English to a grocer. He got a room, three meals a day and a little pocket of money in return. He wasn't sure that his pupil learnt English, but he learnt a lot of Italian.

title: The Bag They Missed
summary: The van was carrying factory wages. The thieves stopped the van and tied up the driver. The police found the van near the river. The driver said that the thieves took one of the bags that contained letters not wages. It was sat on by the driver.

title: Ready Money
summary: A young man was wearing boots and a dirty jacket to a showroom. He wanted to buy 16 expensive cars. He didn't get good service at the first. He was served well in second place. He earns a lot of money from work on a Norwegian fishing boat. He bought the cars for himself and his 15 colleagues.

title: A Dirty Suit
summary: Mrs Field showed Mr Field his dirty suit. He must have his suit cleaned. He would take it to the cleaner's. He always buys dark suits. He doesn't like light-colored ones because it would show the dirt. Dark suits don't really show the dirt so he can clean it once a month.

title: A Day's Shooting
summary: My uncle goes shooting during the weekend. This Sunday he didn't shoot many birds. He spent the day arguing with a farmer. He wanted to aim the bird, but he slipped and shot a cow. He had to pay 50 pounds.

title: A Quiet Life
summary: William Harris has lived a quiet life alone since his wife died twelve years ago. One night, he felt a presence in his house which turned out to be a poltergeist he named Poldy. Instead of being afraid, William welcomed Poldy's company and they became companions, making his quiet life less lonely.

title: Money Problem
summary: John worked in the bank. He wanted to quit the job. Frank wondered why he wanted to quit his job as his career would be great. John answered that he didn't like to count other people's money.
